title: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd — Shareholders meeting
text: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of Annual General Meeting held on August 28, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
